fun.why: Lee Sin, Twisted Fate and Rengar are easy; the rest (Fizz R, Thresh Q, LeBlanc E, Zyra seeds) are real deep cuts, so it skews hard. Many players will waste attempts on plain-reveal champions.

champion:LeeSin.why: Sonic Wave on Evelynn/Shaco is the classic answer.

champion:Rengar.why: Thrill of the Hunt is well known.

champion:Kaisa.why: Void Seeker True Sight is semi-known.

champion:Lulu.why: Pix on an enemy grants True Sight; few remember.

champion:Nidalee.why: Hunt True Sight; jungle players know.

champion:Thresh.why: Death Sentence True Sight is rarely known.

champion:Fizz.why: The fish grants True Sight; surprising.

champion:Leblanc.why: Ethereal Chains True Sight; rarely known.

champion:Zyra.why: Seeds granting True Sight is a deep cut.

gemCandidates.why: 'Oh of course!': the shark-bait fish sticks to them, so stealth can't save them. About 0.08.
The hook latch grants True Sight, which explains landing it on Evelynn; about 0.1.
Ethereal Chains grants True Sight; LeBlanc players will know it. About 0.06.
